source_text: Venit Amalech et pugnavit. Hostis infirmos a tergo caedit. Oratio Moysi manus elevat; crux vincit.
pass_a_gloss: Came Amalek and fought. Enemy weak from behind cuts-down. Prayer of-Moses hands raises; cross conquers.
pass_b_english: [[Amalek came and fought >> Bible:Exodus 17:8]] — the enemy strikes the weak from behind. Moses’ raised hands are prayer; the cross-shaped posture conquers.
